nav.exitLabel: Quick exit: clears everything and leaves

welcome.how1: In Hindi, Kannada, Tamil, English, or a mix. Say it the way you would to a friend.
welcome.how2: See what your symptoms may be associated with, in simple words, read aloud if you like.
welcome.how3: Know which doctor to see and how soon, and carry a doctor-ready summary.
welcome.statement: Sakhi never diagnoses. It helps you understand your body and guides you to the right care, in your language.
welcome.private: Private by design. Your conversations are never stored.

consent.label: BEFORE WE BEGIN
consent.p1: Sakhi gives health information, not a diagnosis. It's not for emergencies. Call 112 if you need urgent help.
consent.p2: To understand you, your voice is processed by Sarvam AI and your text by Anthropic's Claude. We don't store your voice or conversation on our servers. Nothing is saved on your phone unless you choose to.
consent.p3: Designed around consent, purpose limitation, and data minimisation, in the spirit of India's DPDP Act, 2023.
consent.agree: I understand and want to continue
consent.save: Save my history on this phone
consent.saveHint: Off by default. You can clear it any time.

talk.typeInstead: Or type here, in any language
talk.ex1: My periods haven't come for 3 months and I have pimples
talk.ex2: Periods 3 mahine se nahi aaye, chehre pe baal
talk.ex3: My periods are irregular since they started 2 years ago
talk.micDenied: Microphone is blocked. You can type instead.
talk.notHeard: Sorry, I couldn't hear that clearly. Please try again or type.
talk.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
talk.noTts: Audio replies aren't available in this language yet.

confirm.label: WHAT WE UNDERSTOOD
confirm.title: Did we get this right?
confirm.none: We didn't catch any symptoms yet. Add them below or say a little more.

q.pregnancy_possible: Is there any chance you could be pregnant?
q.age_menarche: How old are you, and when did your periods start?
q.androgen_signs: Have you noticed any of these?
q.mood: How has your mood been lately?
q.trying_to_conceive: Are you trying to get pregnant? You can skip this.

urgency.see_doctor_soon: See a doctor within days to 2 weeks

urgency.self_monitor: Keep track, see a doctor if it continues

result.teen: You're not alone. Talking to a trusted adult, like a parent, guardian, or school nurse, can help, along with a doctor.

urgent.crisisTitle: You don't have to go through this alone.

learn.label: LEARN
learn.rename: On 12 May 2026, PCOS was renamed Polyendocrine Metabolic Ovarian Syndrome (PMOS) through a global consensus published in The Lancet. The new name moves the focus away from "cysts" and toward hormones and metabolism. The change happens over 3 years.

disclaimer: Health information, not a diagnosis. Emergency? Call 112.

auth.note: We keep only your name and login. Never your conversations.
